name: frostsworn-paladin-intercept-redirects-attack-on-champion
notes: Frostsworn Paladin (rpOaAjgtue): "Intercept (Whenever your champion is attacked while this ally is awake, you may redirect that attack to this ally.)" (HasKeyword_Intercept -> GetAvailableInterceptRedirectTargets in Custom/CombatLogic.php). Player 1 has a Frostsworn Paladin on the field; player 2 (turn 2) attacks player 1's champion with a seeded Dungeon Guide (1 power). The "Choose_an_interceptor" prompt offers the Paladin; redirecting moves the attack to it, so the Paladin takes the 1 damage and the champion takes none.

rulesClauses: Intercept: Whenever your champion is attacked while this ally is awake, you may redirect that attack to this ally.
